title: Olanzapine, Haloperidol, Ziprasidone, Midazolam for Acute Undifferentiated Agitation
brief_summary: The goal of this research investigation is to conduct a prospective observational study of the comparative efficacy of haloperidol versus olanzapine versus midazolam versus ziprasidone for the treatment of acute undifferentiated agitation in the emergency department.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Emergency Department patients (18+) with acute undifferentiated agitation requiring chemical sedation at the discretion of the attending emergency physician

Exclusion Criteria:

* Known pregnancy
* Allergy to the medication during the block
* Prisoner/under arrest
study_population: Emergency Department patients with acute undifferentiated agitation requiring chemical sedation at the discretion of the attending emergency physician. Patients studied are from a population where agitation is predominantly due to alcohol, illicit substances, or psychiatric agitation.
